listing.jobDescription:
General Description: 
 
The DMPK Department of BeOne Medicines is seeking a highly motivated individual to be the DMPK function representative to lead DMPK and PK/PD modeling efforts. The successful
candidate must have in depth knowledge of DMPK and PK/PD modeling and simulation to provide DMPK expert opinion from hit identification,
lead optimization, candidate profiling, to IND and beyond.
 
Essential Functions of the job:
·       Closely collaborate with project teams to define DMPK screening strategy and TPP
·       Solve ADME/PK challenges, facilitating the discovery and development of high quality clinical candidates
·       Provide human PK and dose prediction, DDI risk assessments and input for Phase I clinical design
·       Conduct comprehensive PK/PD analysis using PK/PD modeling to facilitate PK/PD understanding and clinical translation
·       Use PBPK modeling to predict human PK and evaluate DDI risk
·       Provide DMPK and PK/PD expertise and input into related documents such as Investigator Brochures, SOPs, study reports, manuscripts, summaries for regulatory authorities, INDs, NDAs and sNDAs.
·       Other duties as assigned.
listing.title: 研究员，药代动力学代表Research Investigator, DMPK representative(博士)
